commons.title: Edward S. Curtis, Saguaro gatherers, Maricopa, Arizona, 1907.jpg
commons.description:
"Saguaro gatherers, Maricopa, Arizona" (1907).

Three Maricopa women with baskets on their heads, standing by Saguaro cacti in southern Arizona.
From The North American Indian, by Edward S. Curtis.
commons.editorial_reason: The title and description specifically identify Maricopa women, and the image visibly shows traditional basket-carrying activity and associated material culture.

commons.title: Pakit, Maricopa, by Edward S. Curtis, 1907.jpg
commons.description:
"Pakit, Maricopa" (1907).

Photograph of Pakit, a young Maricopa woman, in Arizona.
Published in: The North American Indian / Edward S. Curtis. [Seattle, Wash.] : Edward S. Curtis, 1907-30, v. 2, pl. 70. by Edward Sheriff Curtis, 1907.
commons.editorial_reason: Although identified as a Maricopa woman, this is a portrait without clearly visible traditional dress, craft, adornment, or performance.
